testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect ribbon appearance choices without changing the display mode: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/display-snapshot/checkout/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:615:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect ribbon appearance choices without changing the display mode ✔ Given a part has an active editable sketch in the MCAD Software ✔ And ribbon appearance is set to Normal ✔ When the user opens Ribbon Appearance from the Create panel title context menu ✔ Then Normal is checked ✔ And Text Off, Small, Compact, Large and Reset Ribbon are listed ✔ When the user presses Escape twice ✔ Then the Ribbon Appearance submenu remains open ✔ When the user clicks in the viewport outside the menu ✔ Then the panel context menu closes ✔ And the ribbon remains in Normal appearance ✔ And the sketch remains active and unchanged
